title: Street lights, poles and hardware
description: Traffic signals, lamps, utility poles, road signs, roadside services and separate hardware pieces.

included: All 68 older traffic signs and modular parts
All 117 newer short-post road sign designs
101 City Props lamps, utility hardware, sign notices, bollards, cones and barriers
excluded: Buildings and the giant ice-cream kiosk despite its cone filename
Beach/station/military/house lighting and unrelated thematic signs
Unsearched master/alias occurrences and cross-design compatibility

Unmatched selected legacy coordinates use exact native copies: Traffic_Light_1, Traffic_Light_2, Traffic_Light_3, Traffic_Light_4, Traffic_Light_6, Traffic_Light_7, Traffic_Light_8, Traffic_Light_9, Traffic_Light_10, Traffic_Light_11, Traffic_Light_12, Traffic_Light_13, Traffic_Light_14, Traffic_Light_15, Traffic_Light_16, Traffic_Lights_Right_1, Traffic_Lights_Back_1, Traffic_Light_New_Front_Diagonal_Right_Up_1, Traffic_Sign_New_64, Traffic_Sign_New_65, Street_Lamp_1, Street_Lamp_2, Street_Lamp_3, Street_Lamp_4, Hydrant_2, Hydrant_3, Drinking_Fountain_2, Phone_Booth_2, Phone_Booth_4, Mailbox_1, Info_Sign_1, Info_Sign_2, Info_Sign_3, Info_Sign_4, Info_Sign_5, Info_Sign_6
scope.method: Visual first pass over every selected named-export contact sheet and relevant master context; selected exact legacy-index crops checked against native exports; missing index entries copied byte-identically. No exhaustive origin, alias or absence search.
